subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: kb/Work PB1398 landed (wave 1004 D). An alphanumeric function result is the data item of category alphanumeric (cite.py --check 8.5.2.3 'an item is referred to as an alphanumeric' OK; 15.2 item 1; 8.4.3.2.1), so FUNCTION LENGTH and FUNCTION BYTE-LENGTH admit it (15.50.3 r1 / 15.14.3 r1): ONE arm, IntrinsicBinder.FunctionResultLength, keyed on the function's 15.2 type for both folds. LENGTH and BYTE-LENGTH of UPPER-CASE(X) over a 3-character item are 3 and 3 (golden 2002/pb1398_length_of_function_result).
